info.title: Reforge
info.description: Roslyn-powered semantic query and refactoring CLI for AI coding assistants

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Reforge — Roslyn-powered semantic query and refactoring CLI for AI coding assistants

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --solution
options.description: Path to solution file (.slnx or .sln). If omitted, searches upward from CWD.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format (compact or json) [default: Compact]

options.name: --limit
options.description: Maximum number of results to return

commands.name: references
commands.description: Find all references to a symbol, solution-wide

arguments.name: SYMBOL
arguments.description: The symbol to find references for

commands.name: callers
commands.description: Find all callers of a method

arguments.name: METHOD
arguments.description: The method to find callers of

commands.name: implementations
commands.description: Find all types implementing an interface or abstract class

arguments.name: INTERFACE
arguments.description: The interface or abstract class to find implementations of

commands.name: members
commands.description: List members of a type with types, visibility, and modifiers

arguments.name: TYPE
arguments.description: The type to list members of

commands.name: dependencies
commands.description: Show what types a class depends on (constructor params, fields, properties)

arguments.name: CLASS
arguments.description: The class to analyze dependencies for

commands.name: injected
commands.description: Find all classes that inject a given type via constructor

arguments.name: TYPE
arguments.description: The type to find injection sites for

commands.name: inheritors
commands.description: Find all types that derive from a base type or implement an interface

arguments.name: TYPE
arguments.description: The base type or interface to find inheritors of

commands.name: call-chain
commands.description: Find transitive callers of a method (who calls who calls this)

options.name: --depth
options.description: Maximum recursion depth [default: 5]

arguments.name: METHOD
arguments.description: The method to find transitive callers of

commands.name: usages
commands.description: Find where a type is used (fields, locals, params, return types, etc.)

options.name: --in
options.description: Filter results to a specific namespace (prefix match)

arguments.name: TYPE
arguments.description: The type to find usages of

commands.name: parameters
commands.description: Find method parameters matching name and/or type criteria

options.name: --name
options.description: Substring match against parameter names (case-insensitive)

options.name: --type
options.description: Substring match against parameter type names (case-insensitive)

commands.name: dbset-usage
commands.description: Find which DbSet properties a service accesses through its DbContext field

arguments.name: CLASS
arguments.description: The class to analyze for DbSet accesses

commands.name: ownership-violations
commands.description: Find services that access tables they don't own

options.name: --owner
options.description: The service that owns these tables

options.name: --tables
options.description: Comma-separated DbSet property names

commands.name: service-map
commands.description: Bird's-eye view of each service's DbSet accesses and injected interfaces

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Filter services by namespace prefix

commands.name: health
commands.description: Analyze code health and rank types by refactoring risk

options.name: --top
options.description: Number of types to show (default: 20) [default: 20]

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Filter by namespace prefix

commands.name: snapshot
commands.description: One-row macro-scale code health record for time-series charting

options.name: --append
options.description: Append one CSV row to this file (writes header if file doesn't exist). Forces --format csv.

commands.name: cycles
commands.description: List circular file dependencies (SCCs) and highest-leverage refactoring targets

options.name: --suggest
options.description: Rank top files inside the core SCC by betweenness centrality (highest-leverage fix targets) [default: False]

options.name: --top
options.description: When --suggest is set, number of fix targets to show (default: 5) [default: 5]

commands.name: audit-auth
commands.description: Find controller actions missing security attributes

commands.name: audit-cache
commands.description: Find SaveChangesAsync calls without corresponding cache eviction

options.name: --cache-method
options.description: Additional cache method names to recognize (e.g., InvalidateCache)

commands.name: audit-immutable
commands.description: Find mutation operations on append-only entities

options.name: --types
options.description: Comma-separated entity type names that should be append-only

commands.name: audit-ef
commands.description: Detect EF Core LINQ patterns that fail at runtime

commands.name: audit-surface
commands.description: Per-method inbound view: caller counts split by prod/test, plus body shape for classes

arguments.name: TYPE
arguments.description: The interface or class to audit (per-method caller counts; class targets get body-shape classification)

commands.name: audit-downstream
commands.description: Per-method outbound view: dependency calls, DbSet read/write (traced through repos), and external IO

arguments.name: CLASS
arguments.description: The class to audit (per-method outbound calls, DbSet accesses, and external IO)

commands.name: skill
commands.description: Print LLM-optimized usage guide for Reforge

commands.name: install
commands.description: Install the reforge skill into Claude Code's global skills directory

commands.name: request
commands.description: Log a feature request for future Reforge improvements

options.name: --list
options.description: Display all logged feature requests [default: False]

options.name: --clear
options.description: Clear all logged feature requests [default: False]

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Start hot workspace server for fast repeated queries

options.name: --port
options.description: TCP port to listen on (default: auto-assign) [default: 0]

options.name: --idle-timeout
options.description: Minutes of inactivity before auto-shutdown (default: 5, 0 to disable) [default: 5]

commands.name: stop
commands.description: Stop a running reforge hot server and clean up its port file
